시편-13-1.title: 시편 13장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-13-1.exegesis: 8. The wicked roam undisturbed doing evil, when vileness and vile men are exalted.
시편-13-1.theologicalNote: 8. The wicked roam undisturbed doing evil, when vileness and vile men are exalted.

시편-13-2.title: 시편 13장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-13-2.exegesis: PSALM 13 Psa 13:1-6 . On title, see Introduction. The Psalmist, mourning God's absence and the triumph of his enemies, prays for relief before he is totally destroyed, and is encouraged to hope his trust will not be in vain. 1. The forms of expression and figure here used are frequent (compare Psa 9:12 , 18 ; 10:11 , 12 ). How long ... for ever-- Shall it be for ever?

시편-13-3.title: 시편 13장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-13-3.exegesis: 2. The counsels or devices of his heart afford no relief.
시편-13-3.theologicalNote: 2. The counsels or devices of his heart afford no relief.

시편-13-4.title: 시편 13장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-13-4.exegesis: 3. lighten mine eyes-- dim with weakness, denoting approaching death (compare 1Sa 14:27-29 ; Psa 6:7 ; 38:10 ).
시편-13-4.theologicalNote: 3. lighten mine eyes-- dim with weakness, denoting approaching death (compare 1Sa 14:27-29 ; Psa 6:7 ; 38:10 ).

시편-13-5.title: 시편 13장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-13-5.exegesis: 4. rejoice-- literally, "shout as in triumph." I am moved-- cast down from a firm position ( Psa 10:6 ).
시편-13-5.theologicalNote: 4. rejoice-- literally, "shout as in triumph." I am moved-- cast down from a firm position ( Psa 10:6 ).

시편-13-6.title: 시편 13장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-13-6.exegesis: 5-6. Trust is followed by rejoicing in the deliverance which God effects, and, instead of his enemy, he can lift the song of triumph.
시편-13-6.theologicalNote: 5-6. Trust is followed by rejoicing in the deliverance which God effects, and, instead of his enemy, he can lift the song of triumph.
